acceptanceCriteria: One test each for: no governing row, subject exclusion, ordering across two passages, promotion of an existing row, routed rows kept when results are withheld.
TCP-V0-047 states whether backticked paths inside fenced code blocks are routing candidates, with a test for the chosen rule; `REQUIREMENTS.tsv` is regenerated.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the V1-0186 review (NITs). `internal/contextindex/taskcontext_routed_test.go` covers routing, the cap and span exclusion. Untested: no governing instruction row present; the subject path is excluded from routing; ordering across two governing passages; promotion of a path that already has a row; routed rows kept when results are withheld. Open question: backticked paths inside fenced code blocks count as routing candidates, and TCP-V0-047 is silent on it.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #126 (merge 242fde633). Criterion 1: added in 8b697bf, internal/contextindex/taskcontext_routed_test.go has TestTaskContextRoutingIsNotApplicableWithoutAGoverningRow (:178), TestTaskContextRoutingSkipsTheSubject (:197), TestTaskContextOrdersRoutingPassagesByIDF (:212), TestTaskContextRoutingPromotesAnExistingRow (:233) and TestTaskContextKeepsRoutedRowsWhenResultsAreWithheld (:260). Criterion 2: TCP-V0-047 now states that fenced code blocks, fences included, are not routing candidates and closes fences as CommonMark does (docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md:760-764), tested by TestTaskContextRoutingSkipsFencedCodeBlocks (:287) and TestTaskContextRoutingClosesFencesAsCommonMark (:301); trace row at :1091. REQUIREMENTS.tsv was regenerated with no byte change. Retest: the routed tests pass at 6d4873a (go test -run Routing ./internal/contextindex). Known limit: a fence indented four or more spaces inside a list item is not recognized. Owner-only: the TCP-V0-047 amendment awaits owner review. Sealed at .corvint/changes/78e3b58678a399a69bdcbd2ec8d3c9f527731fbc.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, taskcontext_routed_test.go, task-context-packet-v0.md.
